Description
PAMP Suisse created this 1-ounce gold bar to celebrate 2023, the Chinese lunar calendar Year of the Rabbit Bar.
The 1 oz Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Year of the Rabbit (In Assay)
shows the precise reasons why it is known as the most beautiful and excellent option for investment. Whereas this product
contains 1 ounce of .9999 fine gold.
A classification system known as the
Chinese Zodiac
gives an animal each year in a 12-year cycle that repeats. The animals like Snakes, rats, horses, goats, Ox, Tiger and others are classified to their perspective months. In Chinese folklore, the animal associated with a given year represents the characteristics of those born in that year. This series begins in the year 2012 with the product dragon bars.
The rabbit is portrayed as having wealth because it is considered to be
the luckiest of the 12 lunar symbols in the Chinese zodiac.
It stands for the virtues of decency, beauty, and watchfulness.
Main Highlights of 1 oz Gold Bar – PAMP Suisse Year of the Rabbit (In Assay)
Contains 1 oz of .9999 fine Gold.
Every gold bar has a gorgeous red assay card that confirms a certified assayer has approved the bar.
On the reverse, a rabbit is seen munching on a carrot from a harvest of vegetables while butterflies flutter above. Napa cabbage, which in traditional Chinese culture symbolizes luck wealth and prosperity, is also visible in the background. The Chinese Kanji for “rabbit” is displayed above the rabbit.
Features the Weight, Fineness and also depicts the rabbit seen from behind.
Features its unique serial number.
Limited to the Year of the Rabbit in 2023.
The bar’s serial number on each Gold Year of the Rabbit bar matches the one on the red assay card, guaranteeing the weight and purity of these PAMP Gold bars.
Design of 1 oz PAMP Suisse Lunar Rabbit Gold Bar (New w/ Assay)
In the year 2023, the rabbit gold bar is the newest product in the
Pamp Lunar Series. Talking about the design 1 oz PAMP Suisse Year of the Rabbit Gold Bar (In Assay),
A picture of a rabbit in a field holding a tipped-over basket of vegetables is shown. Next to the rabbit, two butterflies are seen flitting through the air.
Similarly, Opposite to this design, you will see the back side of the same rabbit with different angles of butterflies flying over the air. And without a rabbit holding carrot. Additionally, pamp Suisse logo as well as the bar’s distinctive hallmarks are inscribed on it.
This product would be a remarkable choice for a birthday gift who has born in the current year of Rabbit. So grab the opportunity to impress and make them full of pleasant by buying rabbit gold bar products.
